text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor requested Transportation Services to investigate the feasibility of providing free parking on sections of Adelaide Street East, Lombard Street and Church Street adjacent to the Masjid Toronto Mosque on Adelaide Street East during the Friday afternoon periods. This report provides information that these requests are not supported, as there are currently no policies in place for these exemptions.
